heading: Today
text: A mix of sun and clouds south.  Periods of clouds north, with a good chance of showers through Quebec, scattered south through the Adirondacks and to Rt. 2.  Highs in the upper 50s to low 60s north, in the 60s south.  South winds, shifting to the west 10 to 15 mph, gusting 20 to 30 mph.

heading: Tonight
text: Any localized evening showers north retreating to the mountains.  Some clearing this evening, then more periods of clouds over the north and mountains.  Lows in the upper 30s to low 40s.  Winds southwest near 10 mph.

heading: Friday
text: Variable clouds and sun.  More clouds in the north and mountains, with a localized shower or two.  Highs from 50 to 60 north to south.  Winds becoming northwest 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph.
